title: Icon widget: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources when multiple Icon widgets are sharing the same containment (panel, folder, etc)
line: When two Icon widgets on the same panel or desktop show the same app from different sources, the Flatpak or Snap one now says so in its label and tooltip and gets a small emblem in panels.
explanation: The Icon widget copies the app's .desktop file and shows only its name and icon, so a distro Konsole and a Flatpak Konsole next to each other looked identical. Each widget knew nothing about the other Icon widgets in its containment. The widget now reads the source from the desktop file (X-Flatpak or X-SnapInstanceName) and, only when another Icon widget in the same containment has the same name but a different source, adds "(Flatpak)" or "(Snap)" to its label, tooltip and accessible name and, in panels where there is no label, a small Flatpak or Snap emblem on the icon. It updates as widgets are added, removed or moved.

commits.message:
applets/icon: tell apart the same app installed from different sources

Icon widgets for one app installed from different sources looked the
same. When another widget next to it has the same name, its label and
tooltip now add where it was installed from, plus an emblem in panels.

BUG: 500735
